crop.notes: Interview with Jem Mace; Allen is mentioned only in one answer.

ocr.notes: Some small errors ('Bell's', 'isthe'); the Allen sentence reads clearly.

title.suggested: Jem Mace talks of his belts and battles

summary.suggested: The St. Joseph Weekly Gazette, quoting the Chicago Tribune, ran an interview with Jem Mace, who said he won the American champion belt by beating Tom Allen for $10,000.

metadata.notes: Reprinted from the Chicago Tribune; Mace says he is 52.

facts.fact: Jem Mace said the champion belt of America was presented to him after he beat Tom Allen for $10,000

notes: Mace says the fight was at the Bowery theatre; other sources place the 1870 fight in Louisiana, so his account is loose. Original spells Mace as 'Jem'; database title says 'Jim'.
